fieldValues.title: Changelog
fieldValues.content: **Retired as an independent content copy (srs#285 / srs#411).** The current, normative text for `ext:changelog` — including its Dormant status and return trigger — is published in §7 as subsection `07-18-ext-changelog` (`com.semanticops.spec/subsection`), byte-identical to this record's prior content. This record is kept only so `ext:changelog` continues to resolve as an RFC-integration token (`scripts/check-rfc-integration.mjs`); it is not rendered by any document view and carries no independent content of its own. Do not edit this field to add prose — edit the published subsection instead.
